# `monitor_dtr`

- **Type:** Integer: `0` or `1`
- **Multiple values:** No

A monitor initial `DTR` line state. See [`pio device monitor --dtr`](../../cli/pio-device/monitor.md#cmdoption-pio-device-monitor-dtr).
